name: Tano
description: Tano is an AI-native influencer marketing agency and AI-powered influencer marketing management platform. It manages end-to-end creator partnership ad campaigns on TikTok and Instagram — sourcing, contracts, payments, content rights, whitelisting, and ad-ready asset delivery.

skills.name: Creator Sourcing
skills.description: AI-driven creator discovery across TikTok and Instagram, matching creators to brand objectives based on audience, content style, and engagement.

skills.name: Creator Partnership Ads
skills.description: End-to-end management of paid creator ad campaigns including content production, whitelisting permissions, and ad-ready asset delivery.

skills.name: Product Gifting
skills.description: Source creators, manage gifting logistics, and collect UGC content at scale.

skills.name: Affiliate Programme Management
skills.description: Recruit, onboard, and manage creators in affiliate channels with monthly ongoing management.
